reason: I'd maybe download the free version for the doctor PDF, but I've quit every tracker within a few weeks because logging feels like homework, so paying for Pro before I've even stuck with the free part makes no sense. An AI write-up of my own log doesn't tell me whether my metformin is working or change what my doctor does.
objection: I'll stop logging after two or three weeks like I always do, and an app summary won't make my doctor take me more seriously or change my treatment.
would_change_my_mind: If I actually kept logging for a couple of months on the free version and the doctor PDF got my doctor to change something, like adjusting my meds or ordering tests, I'd consider paying.
